Popcorn tossed in melted white chocolate tinted pink with freeze-dried raspberry powder, spread to set.
rolls of salmon, cucumber and spicy mayo with soy, wasabi and pickled ginger

Sushi rolls of salmon, cucumber and spicy mayo, with soy, wasabi and pickled ginger. Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, then cook with 480ml water, covered, on low for 12 minutes. Rest 10 minutes. Stir the vinegar with the sugar and 1 tsp salt until dissolved, fold through the rice and cool. Cut the salmon and cucumber into long strips. Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha. Spread a quarter of the rice over each nori sheet, leaving a strip bare at the far edge. Lay salmon, cucumber and a line of spicy mayo along the middle and roll up tight with a mat. Slice each roll into 8 with a wet knife. Serve with soy, wasabi and ginger.

Blane's BMW turkey and avocado club
toasted triple-decker with roast turkey, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and lemon mayo, thin chips

Toasted triple-decker of roast turkey, crisp bacon, avocado, lettuce, tomato and lemon mayo, pinned and cut into triangles with shoestring fries. Bake 800g frozen shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes and salt. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with lemon zest. Toast 12 slices white bread. Build each club as toast, mayo, 100g sliced turkey and lettuce, toast, mayo, 2 rashers bacon, sliced avocado and tomato, toast. Pin with 4 toothpicks and cut into triangles.

Iona's Trax counter pink candied almonds
almonds in a crackly raspberry sugar coat with sea salt, tumbled with salty pretzels

Almonds roasted in a crackly raspberry sugar coat with a pinch of sea salt, tumbled with salty pretzels into a bowl by the record player. Heat 100g caster sugar and 50ml water until dissolved, then add 250g whole almonds and stir over medium heat for 8 minutes until the sugar crystallises and coats them. Keep stirring until some of the sugar melts glossy again. Off the heat, toss with 2 tbsp freeze-dried raspberry powder and a pinch of salt. Spread on baking paper to cool, then mix with 100g salted pretzels.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Rub the cauliflower with the oil, salt and pepper and brown it all over in a heavy casserole.
Tuck the onions, carrots, garlic and potatoes around it. Whisk the tomato paste and soy into the stock, pour in, cover and braise.
Uncover, baste the cauliflower with the stock and roast until golden and a knife slides in easily.
Cut the cauliflower into wedges and serve with the vegetables and stock.

m.note: beef chuck braised slow with onion, carrot, garlic and stock, potatoes added for the last hour
m.how: Season 900g beef chuck roast with 1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Brown all sides in 1 tbsp neutral oil in a heavy casserole for 8 minutes. Add 2 quartered brown onions, 3 chopped carrots, 4 garlic cloves and 500ml beef stock. Cover and braise at 160°C conventional for 3 hours. After 2 hours add 600g peeled potato chunks, cover and cook for the final hour until the beef and potatoes are tender. Rest the beef 15 minutes, slice or pull apart and serve with the vegetables and rich stock.

w.note: pink and white, cut and stitched together like her dress
w.how: Heat the oven to 180°C conventional and line two 12cm round tins. Cook 100g chopped strawberries over low heat for 8 minutes until reduced to about 30g thick purée; cool. Beat 120g softened butter with 120g caster sugar until pale. Beat in 2 eggs, then fold in 140g self-raising flour. Divide the batter equally. Stir 1/2 tsp vanilla into one half and the strawberry purée into the other. Bake side by side for 20 to 25 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool, cut both cakes in half and join one vanilla and one strawberry semicircle using buttercream. Save the spare halves or use them for a second layer. Beat 80g softened butter with 160g icing sugar and 1 tsp milk. Tint half pink. Cover half the cake pink and half white, piping a seam along the join. Cut four portions.

d.note: cranberry and pineapple juice with lemonade, orange slices and frozen raspberries in a glass bowl
d.how: Mix 500ml cranberry juice, 500ml pineapple juice and 750ml lemonade in a big glass bowl. Add 2 sliced oranges and 150g frozen raspberries so they float on top. Ladle into 4 glasses over ice.
